Class ActionSender

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.ActionSenders.ActionSender
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameCommandSender, LobbyCommandSender
public class ActionSender extends Object implements LobbyCommandSender, GameCommandSender
Concrete sender that builds lobby and game commands and pushes them to the server through the client's connection. Implements both LobbyCommandSender and GameCommandSender.
